topic.title: Creating a New Organization
topic.shortdesc: Learn how to create a new organization in Cloud and access its workspace.

body.p: To create a new organization, go to the Cloud main page:
Use the Create new organization action, then follow the steps in the setup wizard to complete the process.
During this process, you will be asked to:

ul.li: Provide the Organization ID. This identifier will be used to generate the organization URL.
Sign up within the organization. You will be assigned the Organization Administrator organization role for the new organization.

body.p: After the organization is created, its workspace will be available at:
where orgid is the identifier you selected during the organization creation process.
After you create your organization, you can invite others to join from the Organization Members page.
